label: nyiso 146c state scoped
definition: KEEPER (promoted nyiso-146, 2026-08-19): the ONLINE-HOURS LSL STATE FLOOR, duty-scoped by the measured run-length gap. Two fields over the superseded keeper 2026-08-18-nyiso-144-layup-exclusion (single-delta at each registered link): nyiso_gas_bridge_online_hours (the ercot141 floor_online_hours detector leg, gas_cc-scoped — a synchronized CC's LSL block is must-take in EVERY P0-online hour) and nyiso_gas_bridge_state_floor_min_run (the floor holds ONLY plants whose measured plant-basis run-length p25 clears the 6.6x population gap: {2539 Bethlehem, 56234 Caithness, 56196 Poletti} at 130-646 h vs the 7-20 h cyclers). Repairs the nyiso-145 CC over-cycling object: Bethlehem 327/526/262 P1 starts (metered 6-7/yr) -> 41/10/15 with median runs 12/7/14 h -> 68/144/319 h; Caithness -> 3/2/4 vs 4/6/8 metered. Zero new fitted scalars; zero new D-4/D-1 findings; criterion statuses identical to control; determination CALIBRATED, C3c the lone ledgered caveat (bit-identical 2/0/5 h).
market_story: CC_REGULAR (near-baseload cohort): a committed combined cycle stays synchronized at or above its minimum stable load through the hours between its economic dispatch peaks — the DAM commits the unit for operating days, not for the LP's hour-by-hour bid-cost re-decision, so Bethlehem/Caithness/Poletti run 5-10 long runs a year in reality. The state floor carries that committed-state inflexibility at the measured CC min-load fraction; the duty scoping keeps it off the intermediate-duty CCs whose real conduct (measured run p25 7-20 h) is daily cycling.
